course.title: Industrial Management
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Company D is going to manufacture a new mobile. The estimate that the fixed cost associated with manufacturing will be 400,000 taka per year. If base unit sells for 1,475 taka and its variable cost is 1,037.5 taka, then:
i) Quantify the number of units must be sold each year for breakeven, and
ii) What will the profit be for sales of 3,000 units per year?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
